sources.supports: Greedy refill accumulates credit; bucket burst/refill differs from an exact rolling-window quota. Cache-entry expiration can be based on the time required to refill consumed allowance. No Bucket4j library runtime was executed.
429 describes rate-limiting, may carry Retry-After, must not be stored by a cache; generating each rejection can itself consume overload resources, so other protection is permitted.

sources.supports: Asynchronous replication and acknowledged-write loss on failover mean atomic primary operations alone do not prove durable global debits; WAIT does not by itself provide strong consistency.

sources.version: Google SRE, Handling Overload, criticality/utilization sections
sources.supports: Priority follows business impact rather than latency alone; overload signals and criticality are application-specific. Google implementation examples are not universal defaults.
nanoTime measures elapsed intervals within a JVM, has an arbitrary process origin and cannot safely compare raw origins across processes; signed differences have the documented 2^63-nanosecond bound.
